instructions.content: The server is authoritative for all game state
Validate room state changes before applying them
Make reconnection and drop handling explicit
Matchmaking metadata must reflect real room capability and stay consistent with runtime state
Step 1: define state models in Schema
Step 2: implement room lifecycle hooks (onCreate, onJoin, onLeave, onDrop) with players added on join and removed on leave
Step 3: register message handlers with payload validation
Checkpoint: verify schema sync with a test client, confirming field changes propagate and no plain properties hold game-critical state
Step 5: wire matchmaking and metadata filters, setting room metadata in onCreate from options
Step 6: add a reconnection policy and timeout behaviour using allowReconnection with a bounded timeout
Checkpoint: simulate a transient disconnect and confirm allowReconnection restores the session without ejecting the player prematurely
Step 8: verify full room behaviour with local multi-client runs
Follow the validation pattern: parse the payload with schema validation, enforce role or ownership, enforce gameplay constraints (cooldowns, ranges, turn order), then apply the mutation
Rate-limit spam-prone message types
Use bounded reconnection grace by mode: casual 20-30 seconds, ranked 10-15 seconds, tournament strict with admin override
Use MapSchema<Player> keyed by sessionId for per-player state
Check reconnection operations: reconnected clients rebind to prior player state, duplicate sessions are rejected, expired tokens are invalidated
NEVER trust client position or score updates directly
NEVER mutate non-Schema fields expecting automatic sync
NEVER skip reconnection handling for transient disconnects
NEVER expose privileged room messages to all clients
